environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate in an isolated subnet (no IGW, no NAT). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b2c1d3e5f6a7 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalAppRole. The endpoint's associated security group (sg-9f8e7d6c5b) permits inbound TCP/8443 only from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (internal app subnet). No public hosted zone exists; the service resolves only via Route53 private hosted zone linked to the consumer VPC. Additionally, the Fargate task role has no outbound internet permissions and the subnet route table contains only local VPC routes (no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry).

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW, no NAT gateway)
config.route_table: rtb-aabb1122: local 10.200.0.0/16 only, no default route
config.dns_resolution: Route53 private hosted zone (oauth.internal.corp) linked to consumer VPC only
config.public_dns: none - no public hosted zone, no internet-resolvable name
config.task_role_policy: no s3/internet egress, only DynamoDB and CloudWatch within VPC endpoints
